provenance.canonicalisation: RFC 8785 JCS via scripts/jcs.py; set hash is SHA-256 over JCS(vectors).
provenance.signatures: Ed25519 over domain || lowercase SHA-256 hex using fixed public test seeds; dependency-free RFC 8032 verifier.
provenance.status: candidate — no Demos runtime guarantee and no second-implementation cross-run yet
provenance.syntheticProofProfile: demos-bft-proof/test-1 fixtures define outputHash as SHA-256(JCS(storageOutput)), SHA-256(JCS(native transfer payload)), or SHA-256(JCS({accepted:true,operationId})); effectsRoot is SHA-256(JCS({pre,post})). These are test-only formulas, not production Demos wire claims.

coverage.note: ruleRefs provide rule-ID coverage; absence from a polarity set is an explicit conformance gap, not implicit coverage.

vectors.name: aws-structured-network-slot-cas
vectors.reason: Consensus proof binds the network-scoped structured slot; global CAS precedes payment.

vectors.name: aws-type-strict-phase-index
vectors.reason: String phaseIndex and integer phaseIndex are distinct.

vectors.name: aws-slot-proof-tuple-mismatch
vectors.reason: Claimant tuple cannot replace the tuple authenticated by the ledger proof.

vectors.name: aws-slot-cas-after-payment
vectors.reason: The signed operation graph cannot place payment before the global CAS.

vectors.name: aws-conflict-digest-derived
vectors.reason: Conflict digest is derived from the complete settlement tuple.

vectors.name: aws-commitment-other-job-substitution
vectors.reason: A valid commitment for another job cannot substitute for the artifact signed inside the Purchase Work.

vectors.name: aws-arbitrary-payer-account
vectors.reason: A self-consistent digest and transfer cannot replace the payer account derived from the authenticated paying-key claim.

vectors.name: aws-arbitrary-payee-account
vectors.reason: A self-consistent digest and transfer cannot replace the payee account derived from the authenticated seller bundle.

vectors.name: aws-arbitrary-roster-native-account
vectors.reason: A signed roleRoster nativeAccount remains an expectation and cannot replace authenticated account derivation.

vectors.name: aws-initial-generation-zero
vectors.reason: Generation zero is the initial signed slot-generation boundary.

vectors.name: aws-conflict-digest-mismatch
vectors.reason: A different/false digest is rejected before payment.

vectors.name: aws-occupied-slot-conflict
vectors.reason: A distinct Work conflict cannot claim an occupied slot.

vectors.name: aws-inflight-exact-replay
vectors.reason: In-flight exact replay reconciles without a transfer.

vectors.name: aws-settled-exact-replay
vectors.reason: Settled replay returns the receipt bound by slot state.

vectors.name: aws-retry-after-rollback
vectors.reason: The first generation advance binds the generation-zero failure receipt, retains the digest, and derives a new Work.

vectors.name: aws-retry-on-not-found
vectors.reason: Not-found leaves the authoritative slot held.

vectors.name: aws-sessionstore-not-authority
vectors.reason: SessionStore cannot override authenticated global slot state.

vectors.name: aws-distinct-atomic-evidence
vectors.reason: A versioned evidence artifact preserves the legacy ChainTxRef contract.

vectors.name: aws-both-evidence-discriminators
vectors.reason: Atomic and legacy evidence discriminators cannot coexist.

vectors.name: aws-neither-evidence-discriminator
vectors.reason: Evidence without either discriminator is rejected before interpretation.

vectors.name: aws-phase-orchestrator-signature
vectors.reason: A payer signature cannot substitute for the authenticated phase orchestrator signature.

vectors.name: aws-legacy-txref-not-reinterpreted
vectors.reason: demos:{txHash} is not reinterpreted as a Work operation.

vectors.name: aws-final-work-receipt-bound
vectors.reason: Final receipt, committed operation leaf, and settlement payload are verified together.

vectors.name: aws-failure-work-receipt-bound
vectors.reason: Failure evidence selects a verified rolled-back operation leaf and carries a reason without success-only fields.

vectors.name: aws-failure-leaf-status-invalid
vectors.reason: Failure evidence cannot select a committed operation leaf.

vectors.name: aws-failure-reason-missing
vectors.reason: Failure evidence requires a non-empty reason.

vectors.name: aws-failure-success-field-forbidden
vectors.reason: Failure evidence cannot carry success-only payment members.

vectors.name: aws-failure-proof-missing
vectors.reason: A missing failure operation proof is indeterminate.

vectors.name: aws-receipt-proof-missing
vectors.reason: Missing final Work receipt/proof remains indeterminate.

vectors.name: aws-receipt-hash-mismatch
vectors.reason: Contradictory receipt hash fails.

vectors.name: aws-pc2-context-anchoring
vectors.reason: PC2 job, rail and phase are checked before SB-1/SB-2 projection.

vectors.name: aws-pc2-rail-mismatch
vectors.reason: A cross-rail PC2 rebind is rejected.

vectors.name: aws-pc2-malformed-cf4
vectors.reason: Lowercase or otherwise non-canonical CF-4 escapes are malformed.

vectors.name: aws-operation-kind-and-leaf
vectors.reason: Pay evidence must reference its committed payment operation leaf.

vectors.name: aws-versioned-settlement-id
vectors.reason: SB-2 uniqueness uses a new domain-separated identity over the operation reference.

vectors.name: aws-sig5-additive-reference-members
vectors.reason: Unknown signed reference members remain authenticated while the six required operation-reference fields alone determine settlement identity.

vectors.name: aws-settlement-id-mismatch
vectors.reason: A claimed settlement identity is independently recomputed.

vectors.name: aws-payment-address-generation-mismatch
vectors.reason: Atomic payment evidence address generation derives from the verified terminal slot, not caller state.

vectors.name: aws-atomic-publication-exact-replay
vectors.reason: A byte-identical replay of the complete signed evidence reconciles against its authenticated finalized publication.

vectors.name: aws-atomic-publication-competing-bytes
vectors.reason: Different signed bytes cannot replay at the immutable Atomic evidence address.

vectors.name: aws-atomic-publication-address-mismatch
vectors.reason: The finalized publication must bind the derived Atomic evidence address.

vectors.name: aws-atomic-publication-content-hash-mismatch
vectors.reason: The publication content hash must cover the complete signed evidence bytes.

vectors.name: aws-atomic-publication-unfinalized
vectors.reason: A submitted but unfinalized publication cannot establish Atomic evidence.

vectors.name: aws-atomic-publication-proof-missing
vectors.reason: Absent authenticated publication lifecycle proof leaves Atomic evidence publication indeterminate.

vectors.name: aws-audit-tail-payment-resubmit
vectors.reason: Audit repair cannot replay Purchase payment.

vectors.name: aws-delivery-evidence-address
vectors.reason: Verified Completion storage leaf projects to the exact Atomic delivery address and content.

vectors.name: aws-delivery-content-mismatch
vectors.reason: Signed delivery evidence cannot change the content hash proven by its storage leaf.

vectors.name: aws-delivery-address-phase-mismatch
vectors.reason: Atomic delivery address binds the authenticated delivery phase index and settlement identity.

vectors.name: aws-slot-key-display-collision
vectors.reason: Network and rail remain separate typed components despite a concatenation collision.
